etsy.title: Preheated Emotionally Sticker, Funny Baking Decal, Baker Gift, Retro Kitchen Humor Laptop Sticker
etsy.description:
A preheated emotionally sticker for bakers who are ready long before the oven is.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• One physical kiss-cut vinyl sticker, shipped directly to you
• Available in 3×3 in and 4×4 in
• Glossy finish, with a backing that peels away cleanly

HOW TO USE
Peel and stick on a laptop, recipe binder, notebook, or planner. Made for indoor use, so keep it dry.

This listing is a physical sticker, not a digital download. Thank you for supporting a small shop!
